summary: I read every owned unit, s0058-s0076. Jinshu's only explicit anchor is 咸康三年 (AD 337, s0056); I checked the later relative sequence against Zizhi Tongjian vols. 95-96. The enthronement appointments are 337, Song Hui's mission is 337, the Shi Hu campaign, Jicheng siege and Miyun ambush are 338, the Jin promotion is 338 (4th month), and the Liaoxi battle, Duan Liao's execution and Liu Xiang's dispatch are 339. 52 of 53 items and all 18 people are supported. The Cao Cao and Sima Zhao rows are now correctly retrospective references. One item is incorrect: claim-223 (Duan Liao, p038) has a spliced sourceDate and an unexplained 339 endpoint that is inconsistent with its sibling claims. No owned unit omits a birth, death or age; 旬餘 in s0065 is a duration, not a date. The duplicate person records (p035/p075, p038/p081/p157, p069/p077) are an identity matter outside this date review. This is not a full chapter or publication approval.

findings.problem: claim-223 (Duan Liao p038) has a sourceDate.text that splices s0056 and s0070 with a semicolon; s0056 is not in its evidence and the result is not a source date. Its westernInterval ends in 339, but every cited event (s0060-s0071) is 338 in Tongjian, and the same Miyun episode is dated 337-338 on claims 255-258.
